[[Suki]] crafts armor for [[core]] professions using the [[Ascalon armor]] art and [[Factions]] professions using the [[Seitung armor]] art. Suki also crafts [[Ranger masks]], [[Monk scalp designs]], [[Necromancer scar patterns]], [[Mesmer masks]] from [[Prophecies]], as well as [[Elementalist headgear#Auras|Elementalist auras]]. All armor is crafted with a blank [[insignia slot]].
